diagnosis: The 4x4 256-feature spatial encoder reduced training loss but validation peaked and then degraded, demonstrating layout overfitting. Exact map/state/mask observations are unique in the training data, so duplicate-label disagreement is zero. The privileged A* teacher can use unrevealed layout information, but the dominant learnable error remains directional geometry.
changes_for_next_iteration: Reject and revert the overfitting 4x4 encoder.
Restore the compact 2x2 128-feature map encoder and original inverse-frequency class balancing.
Add normalized row and column coordinate channels before convolution to expose directional geometry with few additional parameters.
